name: instantgram
description: A bookmarklet for download photos in Instagram
author: Sascha Heim

scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:bundles && npm run build:release
scripts.build:clean: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Get-ChildItem -Path dist -Filter *.map -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.build:release: npm run build:bookmarklet && npm run build:pages
scripts.build:release:dev: npm run build:bookmarklet:dev && npm run build:pages
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src\components --watch src\helpers --watch src\model --watch src\modules --watch src\_langs\src --watch src\_langs\layouts --watch src\localization.ts --watch src\index.ts --watch scripts --watch package.json --watch rollup.config.js --ignore src\_langs\bookmarklets.js --ext ts,js,json,md,hbs,css --exec "npm run dev:build"
scripts.dev:build: npm run build:bundles && npm run build:release:dev
scripts.dev:watch: nodemon --watch src\components --watch src\helpers --watch src\model --watch src\modules --watch src\_langs\src --watch src\_langs\layouts --watch src\localization.ts --watch src\index.ts --watch scripts --watch package.json --watch rollup.config.js --ignore src\_langs\bookmarklets.js --ext ts,js,json,md,hbs,css --exec "npm run dev:build"
scripts.size:build: npm run build:bundles && npm run build:bookmarklet && npm run size
